scenario: Multi-justification lifecycle, partial withdrawal: a keyed logical fact emitted by two rules is ONE fact with two TMS justifications. Withdrawing one justifier (retract its trigger) must leave the fact in place — it is still justified by the other rule. A runtime that builds a second DS wrapper holds 3 facts (Trig + two Mark) instead of 2.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key
schema Gate scope logical:
    g: Int key
schema Mark scope logical:
    step: String key
rule from_trig:
    Trig
->
    emit Mark logical step: "X"
rule from_gate:
    Gate
->
    emit Mark logical step: "X"
